label: Portfolio turnover
note: Reported in the financial-highlights table of N-CSR/N-CSRS. No direction: high turnover is a strategy choice, not a quality.

label: Non-accrual rate (% of portfolio)
prose_patterns: non-?accrual investments as a percentage of total investments at cost and fair value were\s*[0-9.]+\s*%\s*and\s*([0-9]{1,2}(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)\s*%
note: Proxy for default rate, on a FAIR VALUE basis. Filers commonly state cost and fair value in the same sentence -- 'were 0.6% and 0.3%, respectively' -- and the two are not interchangeable. Disclosed in 10-K narrative, not tagged.

label: Weighted average spread (bps)
note: Stated inconsistently across filers -- some quote spread over benchmark, some all-in yield. Expect low coverage and check the excerpt before using.
